subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 24, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - September 24, 2026. Here is your summary of today's development, community, and highlights for the AcreetionOS ecosystem.

Welcome to another AcreetionOS update. This morning we have a mix of upstream community news and internal development progress to share with you.

The upstream community has released systemd v262, which includes a notable feature for building systemd as a single statically linked binary ideal for small containers. This release also brings support for the kernel coredump handler, which may benefit some of our containerized workflows.

On the development front, our CI pipeline has received several important fixes this week. The release workflow now correctly passes the -R flag to gh release create to avoid unnecessary checkouts, and we resolved a block-scalar indentation issue in release.yml that was breaking validation.
